identityReview: Federica Mogherini, born in Rome on 16 June 1973, Italian former Chamber deputy and foreign minister, former EU High Representative and Commission Vice-President, former College of Europe rector and EU Diplomatic Academy director. Do not confuse national and European parliaments, Senate-hosted records with Senate membership, national NATO parliamentary delegation leadership with NATO Secretary General, or College rector with an earned doctorate. Both educational leadership roles ended in December 2025.
lifeStatusEvidence: Johns Hopkins SAIS Europe’s 3 November 2026 event page includes a retrospective account of her completed talk and student discussion, with specific arguments attributed to her. This supports recent personal activity; it is not solely a future event listing.

sourceReview.accessMethod: Read the updated College biography, rector chronology and appointment announcement; the Senate-hosted printable parliamentary record; the Italian ministry biography; archived EEAS assumption-of-office and two nuclear-agreement statements; EPPO’s 2 and 3 December 2025 releases; Reuters’s resignation report; and the SAIS Europe event recap. Read Commons parent/crop metadata and the Commission copyright-menu page; original audiovisual item page timed out.
corrections: Read the updated College of Europe biography. It explicitly ends the rector term in December 2025 and the EU Diplomatic Academy directorship in December 2025, the latter starting in August 2022. It supports the Sapienza political-science degree, 2008–2014 Chamber service, 2014–2019 EU offices and January 2020–September 2021 co-chairmanship of the UN internal-displacement panel. Do not retain present-tense leadership from older partner biographies or infer a research doctorate from rector status. Internal displacement is distinct from crossing an international border as a refugee. Peripheral advisory memberships are not all independently refreshed or reproduced.

Read the Senate-hosted printable XVII-legislature record after the historical URL returned a JavaScript challenge. It explicitly says deputy, identifies birth in Rome on 16 June 1973, and dates resignation from the Chamber for incompatibility to 30 October 2014. The ministry record separates Minister of Foreign Affairs, 22 February–28 August, from the expanded Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation title, 29 August–31 October 2014. The host being the Senate does not make her a senator. Distinguish Chamber resignation from ministerial departure and later EU assumption of office.

Read the Italian foreign ministry’s historical biography. It confirms elections in 2008 and 2013 and the 1 August 2013 election as head of Italy’s NATO Parliamentary Assembly delegation. That role is not NATO Secretary General or chair of the entire alliance. The parliamentary defence committee secretary role is not national defence minister. Older party and association descriptions are historical context, not a comprehensive current-office list.

Read EEAS’s archived 1 November 2014 article. It dates actual succession to Catherine Ashton and the combined High Representative, Commission Vice-President and EEAS leadership roles. August appointment and October parliamentary hearing preceded assumption of office. Its 2008 first election overrides a search-visible EPRS summary saying 2009. The quoted aspirations for a common policy are not proof of achieved institutional unity. The exact end date is not taken from an original appointment’s projected October 2019 endpoint; the later handover occurred in December 2019.

Read the 14 July 2015 Mogherini–Zarif statement from Vienna announcing the final JCPOA text negotiated with the E3/EU+3. It describes collective negotiations and prospective implementation, not an agreement personally authored or implemented by her alone. Distinguish agreement, later adoption/implementation and later international developments. It concerns nuclear-related sanctions rather than all sanctions on Iran. Claims about future exclusively peaceful activity and lasting security are commitments or expectations, not guarantees of permanent compliance. Linked full agreement, annexes and video were not all inspected.

Read the 16 January 2016 joint statement on Implementation Day. It says the IAEA had verified the relevant commitments for that stage, while the High Representative coordinated the Joint Commission. Diplomatic coordination is not personal technical nuclear inspection. Nuclear-related economic and financial sanctions relief is not universal removal of every sanction, and this historical statement is not a description of the 2026 sanctions regime or a guarantee of later compliance.

Read the current historical rectors list, which gives 1 September 2020–4 December 2025 for Mogherini. It separately lists Ewa Ośniecka-Tamecka from 12 December 2025 through 30 June 2026 and João Gomes Cravinho from 1 July 2026. This supports completed departure and prevents preserving a stale current-rector title. Do not fill the interval between 4 and 12 December with an invented acting appointment. The roster is an office chronology, not a criminal finding.

Read the College’s appointment announcement with a 26 May 2020 press-release link and the explicit future start of 1 September 2020. It identifies the Administrative Council’s appointment on the Academic Council’s proposal and predecessor Jörg Monar. The earlier visiting-professor role is not an earned doctorate or prior rector tenure. The later historical roster confirms the appointment actually took effect. Current footer links to campuses do not prove all campuses existed or operated under the same arrangement in May 2020.

Read the EPPO’s 2 December 2025 release. It describes searches authorised by the investigating judge, three detained suspects, and the 2021–2022 tender for EU-funded junior-diplomat training. The alleged advance sharing of tender information and possible offences are investigative suspicions, not established guilt. The release does not name the suspects; her identity is corroborated by the following role-specific release and Reuters. OLAF supported the process; prosecutors, investigating judge and Belgian police have distinct roles. The event was not an arrest during her 2014–2019 EU tenure.

Read EPPO’s 3 December 2025 follow-up. The rector, a senior College employee and a senior Commission official had been detained the previous day. After questioning they were formally notified of accusations involving procurement fraud/corruption, conflict of interest and professional secrecy, then released because they were not considered flight risks. Release is not acquittal or discontinuance; formal notification is not conviction, nor proof that a full criminal trial had already begun. The office states the presumption of innocence and withholds further details to protect the investigation.

Read Reuters’s 4 December 2025 account of her resignation statement and her lawyer’s denial of wrongdoing and confirmation of cooperation. It links her personally to the procurement investigation, while the college roster corroborates the end of the rector term. Allegations remain attributed and unproven in these records. Another suspect’s retirement plans are not her retirement or a dismissal verdict. The historical photograph caption is not a new 2025 diplomatic office or proof of a 2025 press conference. This report alone does not establish a final 2026 judicial outcome.

Read Johns Hopkins SAIS Europe’s event recap under the 3 November 2026 event. It records a completed talk and discussion with students, facilitated by Nathalie Tocci, about military threats, democratic resilience, interdependence and European strategic autonomy. This is recent actual personal activity rather than only an invitation or prospective programme. Her views, time horizons for capabilities and suggested coalitions are political analysis, not adopted EU or NATO decisions. No recording was viewed and no separate transcript was inspected.

additionalConsulted.access: Read official meeting results confirming Josep Borrell had been High Representative since 1 December 2019. The date of his first Foreign Affairs Council on 9 December is not his assumption-of-office date.

translationReview.scope: All 32 display fields in seven foreign languages checked against Chinese and English. Preserve Chamber versus Senate/European Parliament; the 2014 ministerial-title change and distinct Chamber/minister resignation dates; appointment versus assumption of EU/College office; former rector and director status; 2015 agreement versus 2016 implementation and diplomatic coordination versus IAEA verification; national NATO parliamentary delegation versus alliance leadership; internal displacement versus cross-border refugees; detention, questioning, formal notification, release, resignation and conviction as distinct concepts; allegation versus denial; and actual November 2026 discussion versus adopted policy.
